name: Image
description: Frames pictures with loading feedback and a fallback when the image fails.

alt.description: What the image shows; also the words the built-in error fallback prints

objectFit.description: How the image fills the frame: cover crops, contain letterboxes on the band

radius.description: Corner role. none leaves the corner to the container that clips it

fallback.description: Replaces the built-in error fallback (band, glyph and the alt words)

imgProps.description: Additional props for the underlying img element (except src/alt/size/style/events)

onImageLoad.description: Called when the underlying img element loads

onImageError.description: Called when the underlying img element fails to load

when: Product shots, thumbnails, and hero art
Uploads you do not control and cannot trust to load
whenNot: Pure decoration behind content (use a CSS background)
guidelines: Set aspectRatio so a grid holds its shape before the file arrives
Leave radius at none inside a card or frame that already clips its corner
The built-in fallback prints the alt words; pass fallback only to say something more useful
imgProps, onImageLoad, and onImageError expose the raw img when you need it
accessibility: alt is required — describe what the picture shows
Words baked into an image must be repeated in alt

examples.name: Default
examples.description: src plus alt — the shape follows the file.

examples.name: Aspect Ratios
examples.description: Lock the frame so a grid stays even whatever the file is.

examples.name: Corner Roles
examples.description: none leaves the corner to the container; control, nested and surface are the radius roles.

examples.name: Broken Source
examples.description: A dead URL shows the band, a glyph and the alt words, never a broken-image icon.
examples.code:
<Image
  src="https://invalid-url.example/image.jpg"
  alt="Team photo from the offsite"
  aspectRatio="4:3"
  width={240}
  radius="control"
/>

relations.note: Common pattern to use Image at top of product cards
Use Avatar for user profile pictures

propsSummary: alt: string - accessibility text and the error fallback words (required)
fallback: ReactNode - replaces the built-in error fallback
imgProps/onImageLoad/onImageError - low-level img customization and events
